title: X Video Downloader 2023
summary: Fast Video Downloader & Private Proxy Browser
description:
X Video Downloader is a fast and easy-to-use **video downloader and private proxy browser** that lets you browse websites and download videos with just one click. The built-in video detector automatically detects downloadable videos, making it quick and convenient to save videos for offline viewing.

With built-in **proxy servers from multiple countries**, X Video Downloader helps provide a more private and secure browsing experience while you surf the web.

The powerful **download manager** lets you manage multiple downloads at once. You can pause, resume, or remove downloads, download videos in the background, and continue interrupted downloads with ease.

X Video Downloader also includes a built-in **video player**, allowing you to watch your downloaded videos offline without buffering or requiring an internet connection.

## 🚀 KEY FEATURES
------------------------------------

* **Fast Video Downloader** – Download videos quickly with just one click.
* **Automatic Video Detection** – Automatically detects videos available for download.
* **Private Proxy Browser** – Browse the web with built-in proxy support.
* **Secure & Private Browsing** – Helps protect your privacy while browsing.
* **Built-in Video Player** – Watch downloaded videos offline without internet buffering.
* **One-Click Download** – Download supported videos quickly and easily.
* **Multiple Downloads** – Download several videos simultaneously.
* **Background Downloads** – Continue downloading videos while using other apps.
* **Pause & Resume** – Pause downloads and resume them whenever you want.
* **Resume Failed Downloads** – Continue interrupted or failed downloads.
* **Download Manager** – Easily manage, share, or delete downloaded video files.
* **Wi-Fi & Mobile Data Support** – Download over Wi-Fi and supported mobile networks.
* **Fast Download Speed** – Enjoy a smooth and efficient downloading experience.
* **Website Bookmarks** – Save your favorite websites for quick access.
* **Modern & User-Friendly Interface** – Simple, clean, and easy to navigate.
* **And More** – More useful features to make video downloading easier.
